The result of the joint investigations made
are as follows :-

At about 8.30 p.m. 10-11-37, the first five
mentioned persons were partaking of food at the "So Yuen"
(蘇園) Restaurant, No. 42-50 Rue Wagner, F.C., when
they were approached by the 7th, 8th and 9th described
persons who were soliciting contributions on behalf of
the National Students Training Corps (學生訓練團) for the
purchase of clothing for the Chinese Army. Each of these
three persons wore arm bands bearing the chop of the
above mentioned organisation and carried two books for
the issuance of receipts for donations received. On a
refusal being made to contribute to this Fund, the three
collectors began to upbraid these men for their apparent
lack of patriotism, and took them to task for their
callousness in spending money in restaurants at a time
when China was fighting for freedom etc.

A number of people collected and the 7th
mentioned person taking advantage of this, harangued the
crowd with the result that they turned on the five diners
and accused them of being traitors. Incensed over this

指控他们是汉奸。因受到这种

assaulted one of the collectors. This was witnessed by
the 6th mentioned man who sided with the five persons
accused of being traitors and tried to pacify the crowd.
At this juncture the two Boy Scouts arrived on the
scene and tried to settle the matter amicably, but the
crowd refused to listen and demanded that the five men
be made to pay a sum of money sufficient to purchase two
hundred rain coats for the use of the Chinese Army. The
7th mentioned man, feeling unable to cope with the
situation, then telephoned to the 12th described person,
Loh Kwang Ping, who is in charge of a Sub-Office
established by the National Student Corps at the Kwang
Cha ( ) Middle School, Moulmein Road, and requested
his assistance in this matter. On the arrival of this
man, it was decided to abide by the decision of the mob,
and ways and means of obtaining the money were discussed.
The 13th, 14th, 15th and 16th described persons, also
members of this Student movement, also joined the throng
and lent their support in attempting to coerce the five
men into paying the money demanded.

In view of the hostile attitude of the crowd,
the first mentioned man suggested that he be allowed to
return to his home to obtain the necessary money, whilst
the others remain as hostages. The crowd disagreed with

From enquiries made by Detectives attached
to this branch, it has been ascertained that the National
Students Training Corps functions under the auspices of
the local Tangpu and Bureau of Social Affairs, who now
have offices at the Pootung Guild, No. 1454 Avenue Edward
VII, and the Municipal School, 1197 Rue Lafayette, French
Concession. The person in charge of the National Students
Training Corps is Mr. Pan Koong Chuen (潘公展), but the
man responsible for the collection of monies to be donated
to the Chinese Army is his Secretary Mr. Dau Fah Tsu
(杜发祖).

Questioned as to the distribution of the
monies collected, Loh Kwang Ping, who states that he is
in charge of a sub-office of this organisation at the
Kwang Sha Middle School, stated that he receives the money
and pays it into the Head Office or Sub-Offices of the
Shanghai & Commercial Savings Bank. He admits that he is
not in possession of a paying-in book but states that this

arose, when the 2nd named alleged that the 1st struck
him on the face. The altercation continued outside of
the restaurant and a crowd immediately collected
around 1st and 2nd named.

The crowd took up a hostile attitude towards the
1st named and the concensus of opinion of the crowd was
that the 1st named should be made to give a patriotic
donation equivalent of 200 raincoats. The 1st named
becoming afraid, suggested that he, proceed to his home
in Weihaiwei Road where he might be able to obtain
money from his father for a contribution, he also
suggested that he use his own car S.M.C. Lic. No.8586
dark blue Austin to go there, this suggestion was
cried down by those around him. At this moment 3rd,
4th 5th and 6th named arrived at the scene and joined
the discussion. A short time after some unknown person
called a Johnson Hire Car No.18478, 1st, 2nd, 3rd,
4th, 5th and 6th named entered the car and were duly
driven to the 1st named's home at 325 Weihaiwei Road.

Prior to leaving the vicinity of the restaurant
at Rue Wagner the 1st named was informed by the crowd
at large that should he not return within 15 minutes
with the necessary contribution his car would be
smashed.

目的进行捐款，上述第一人宋某拒绝，遂发生争执，期间上述第二人声称第一人打了他的脸。争吵延续至餐厅外，人群立即围聚在第一人和第二人周围。

人群对第一人采取敌对态度，众人的普遍意见是应迫使第一人捐赠相当于200件雨衣的爱国款项。第一人因害怕，建议前往其威海卫路的家中，称或许能从父亲处筹得捐款，他还建议乘坐其自有汽车（工部局牌照号8586，深蓝色奥斯汀轿车）前往，但该建议被周围人喝止。此时，第三、四、五及六人到达现场并加入讨论。片刻后，有不明身份者叫了一辆约翰逊出租车（车号18478），第一、二、三、四、五及六人进入该车，并被 duly 驶往第一人位于威海卫路325号的住所。

在离开华格纳路餐厅附近之前，人群告知第一人，若他在15分钟内未携必要捐款返回，其汽车将被砸毁。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
On arriving at his home at 325 Weihaiwei Road it
was found that the father of 1st named was not present
he was therefore unable to carry out his intention of
obtaining a contribution from his father.
On realising that the 1st named Soong was unable
fulfil his previous suggestion of obtaining a contri-
bution the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th and 6th named had him
re-enter the car together with them with the intention
of returning to the restaurant at Rue Wagner, where four
of the 1st named's friends were being held by two of
the 2nd named's compatriots. However, while proceeding
south on Chengtu Road at Ave. Foch the car was
challenged by the Police party on duty at No.3 Post
and the 1st named appealed to C.P.S. 20 regarding the
situation in which he had found himself resulting in
the C.D.S. bringing all concerned, to the station as
aforesaid.
The French Authorities were duly informed regarding
the happenings in the Restaurant at Rue Wagner and of
the threat to smash 1st named's m/car, and requested
to take the necessary action. They were also requested
to send a representative to this station in order to
interrogate of the persons concerned. At 10.45 p.m.

Mr. Robertson A.C.P. D.O."A" was appraised of the facts of the case by D.I. Hill and on his instructions all were handed over to the French Authorities at 11.00 p.m. 10.11.37 on the provis that should the French Authorities decide not to lay any charge against 2nd 3rd, 4th, 5th and 6th named they were not to be released but were to be returned to this station where they would be dealt with.

Later at 11.50 p.m. the undersigned attended at Loh Ka Wei Station in order to ascertain what action the French Authorities were taking, and was informed that up to that time they the French Authorities, had not decided whether those concerned were to be charged or not but that they would be detained overnight and in the event of their not being charged they would not be released, but would be duly returned to the custody of this station to be dealt with.

“A”分区副督察长 Robertson 先生由探长希尔告知本案事实，并根据其指示，所有人于1937年11月10日晚上11时移交给法国当局，条件是若法国当局决定不对第二、三、四、五及六名人员提出指控，则不得将其释放，而应送回本捕房进行处理。

随后在晚上11时50分，签署人前往罗家威捕房，以查明法国当局正在采取何种行动，获悉截至当时，法国当局尚未决定是否对相关人员提出指控，但他们将被拘留过夜，若最终不予起诉，他们也不会被释放，而是会 duly 交还本捕房羁押处理。

关于法国当局在此案中采取的行动，将 duly 提交后续报告。
